result.title: ShadowMiner v1 - An Experience Report on Implementing and Measuring a Problem-and-Hypothesis Discovery Engine
result.summary: ShadowMiner v1 is a system that automatically discovers research problems and generates hypotheses from AI papers. It is a nine-stage pipeline. It structures documents into a knowledge graph and finds graph gaps in it - structural blind spots in research. These graph gaps are included in the LLM generation prompt. Each generated hypothesis is then verified by checking whether it is already covered by existing research, scoring its quality, and checking that the facts it relies on are accurately drawn from its sources. This report does not propose a new generation or evaluation technique. It describes our experience of implementing and applying ideas from prior work, and measuring whether each one actually contributed.

AI.brief_summary: 该系统从 AI 论文中自动发现研究问题并提出假设，采用九阶段流水线：将文档结构化为知识图谱、定位图中的结构性空白，再据此提示 LLM 生成假设，并通过查重、质量评分和事实溯源逐条验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「图谱结构空白 + 假设生成 + 事实来源核验」的流程，可能与 LVR 的证据筛选、生成假设的验证与贡献分配问题形成类比，可供核查是否用于视觉证据选择或推理轨迹的自检。
